title: Stop generating sample gardens and preserve pending deletes
purpose: Prevent Leaf sync from restoring a record while its deletion is pending and start new gardens empty.
changes: Removed automatic seeding and recognize untouched complete legacy samples in local storage.
Prioritize pending deletions, retain version conflicts, and preserve local mutations made during a sync push.

data_changes: Recognize intact legacy samples and reuse the existing cloud deletion status.

next_actions: Verify publication and targeted example cleanup.
